result.reasoning: Verified against the .kicad_pcb, all schematic sheets, production contracts, and primary ST documents; the finding holds and is actually understated. (1) Board file line 15918: footprint nSealr_Mechanical:NFC_Antenna_Envelope_42x8mm (ANT1) at (32,33) contains 0 pad definitions and 0 graphic/copper primitives (attr board_only exclude_from_pos_files exclude_from_bom) — it is a bare anchor, not even a drawn envelope. Zero gr_* graphics on F.Cu exist anywhere; the string NFC_ANT appears exactly once in the entire PCB (ANT1's Value text), so no NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 nets exist. (2) The gap extends past the coil: U9's pads 13 (RFO1), 15 (RFO2), 22 (RFI1), 23 (RFI2) carry NO nets on the PCB (pin numbers confirmed against DS13541 Rev 11 Fig. 4 p.19: GND_DR1=12/VDD_DR=14/GND_DR2=16 match board GND/NFC_VCC/GND). The schematic U9 symbol in optional_profiles.kicad_sch is an explicit 'source-backed pin subset' with zero RFO/RFI pins, no EMC filter, no matching caps, no RX divider; the sheet itself notes 'Antenna nets remain measurement-gated'. schematic-binding.json marks NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 'explicitly_unbound' while netlist-contract.json required_buses.nfc_spi REQUIRES both nets and gates release on 'nfc_matching_network_measured_with_final_antenna'. (3) The antenna is not optional: DS13541 §2.1 (p.13-14) shows the 'minimum system configuration' includes the antenna coil and EMC filter on RFO1/2-RFI1/2; AN5276 Rev 6 §3 (p.8) defines the mandatory chain RFO1/2 -> EMC filter -> matching network -> antenna, RX via capacitive divider to RFI1/2. (4) Two facts break the recommendation as given: full-board GND pours on F.Cu, B.Cu AND In1.Cu all fill from y=31.6 across the envelope region (a coil drawn on F.Cu over solid planes would be detuned/Q-killed; only existing keepout is elsewhere at x26.7-29.3/y37.9-39.1), and the 42x8 envelope centered at (32,33) spans y=29-37 while the board top edge is y=30.925, so ~1.93mm hangs off-board leaving only ~42x6.1mm usable. There is also no 'U9 matching network' to retune — it must be created from scratch. result.corrected_recommendation: Do not just 'draw the coil and retune' — there is no matching network to retune; build the RF chain end-to-end. (1) Decide PCB coil vs FPC antenna first (production/placement-plan.json already frames 'FPC OR TUNED KEEP-OUT'); with only ~6.1mm of on-board envelope height and the LiPo directly above the top edge, an enclosure FPC antenna is a serious alternative. (2) Schematic: extend the U9 symbol to the full pin set and add the AN5276 Rev 6 §3 differential chain — EMC filter L_EMC1/2+C_EMC1/2 (§3.3), matching C_S1/2+C_P+R_Q (§3.4), capacitive RX divider into RFI1(22)/RFI2(23) (§3.5) — creating nets NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 exactly as netlist-contract.json required_buses.nfc_spi mandates; seed values from ST's STSW-ST25R004 matching tool. (3) Board: replace the padless ANT1 footprint with a real antenna footprint (two pads on NFC_ANT1/2) fully inside the outline (current envelope y=29-37 vs top edge y=30.925), cut copper+plane keepouts on ALL 4 layers under the coil (the F.Cu/In1.Cu/B.Cu GND pours currently fill to y=31.6 through the envelope), and place EMC filter + matching adjacent to U9 pads 13/15. (4) Treat the first build as a tuning spin: measure the real coil with a network analyzer (AN5276 §4/§7), finalize matching values, and only then consider the existing release gate 'nfc_matching_network_measured_with_final_antenna' passable; keep matching parts 0402/DNP-friendly.

result.area: MCU + secure elements (STM32U585, TROPIC01, OPTIGA, W25Q128, USB, SWD/testpoints)
result.summary: The STM32U585 core decoupling plan is genuinely good: one 100nF within 2.4mm of every power pin (9 caps, verified pad-by-pad against DS13086 Fig 15/Fig 24) and a correctly-valued 4.7uF VCAP at 1.9mm; all peripheral pinmux assignments (SPI1/SPI2/SPI3/OCTOSPI1-PE/USB/SWD/USART2/I2C) check out against the LQFP100 pinout and AF tables. However, the HSE circuit is broken as placed (load caps are literal 'HSE_LOAD' placeholders, one sitting 13.7mm away in the VDD decoupling row; no crystal MPN), NRST has no 100nF (DS Fig 38), and the TROPIC01 is missing the 47k CSN pull-up that appears in its own datasheet typical-application, the official devboard, and Trezor Safe 7. OPTIGA and W25Q128 both lack any local VCC decoupling, the VBAT ADC divider exceeds the DS RAIN limit by ~500x, and LED_G sits on PC15 which has no timer AF and is a restricted backup-domain pin. A cross-cutting process gap amplifies everything: the schematic sheets contain only the 11 major parts, so all support passives exist only in the PCB and the BOM has no passives at all. The 6 contract-required testpoints are missing; a concrete DRC-checkable placement around the TC2030 is proposed.

findings.claim: HSE load caps C18/C19 have placeholder value 'HSE_LOAD' and are misplaced: C19 @(26.5,59.5) is 13.7mm from crystal X1 @(14,54) (it sits in the U1 bottom decoupling row), C18 @(14,47.5) is 6.5mm away; X1 itself has no MPN (value '16MHz') so CL is unknowable.
findings.evidence: pads.json measured distances; grep of all .kicad_sch sheets shows C18/C19/X1 exist only in the PCB; ST AN2867 layout guidance and DS13086 Rev10 HSE requirements; production/bom/pcbway-bom.csv contains no passives.
findings.recommendation: Select a 3225 16MHz crystal MPN (CL 8-12pF, ESR<=80Ohm per AN2867 gm margin), set C18/C19 = 2x(CL - ~3pF stray), move both caps adjacent to X1 pads, and shift X1 ~2mm right toward U1 pins 12/13 (pads at 20.325,49.5/50.0).

findings.claim: NRST (U1 pin 14) has no capacitor - only R19 10k pull-up to SYS_3V3 and J7 pin 3; DS requires 100nF placed close to the device for parasitic-reset protection, which matters doubly on a secure device.
findings.evidence: padnets.json net NRST = {R19.1, J7.3, U1.14}; STM32U575/585 DS13086 Rev10 Figure 38 'Recommended NRST pin protection' p.243, note 3: external 0.1uF 'must be placed as close as possible to the device'; internal RPU 30-50k (Table 102) makes R19 redundant.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF NRST->GND next to U1 pin 14 (free area around (18.5,45.5)); R19 may stay or be removed.

findings.claim: TROPIC01 SPI_CSN (U2 pin 8) has no pull-up: net connects only U2.8 to U1.29 (PA4), so CSN floats whenever the MCU is in reset/boot/low-power while TROPIC_VCC is gated on, risking spurious selects of the secure element.
findings.evidence: TROPIC01 datasheet ODD_TR01 rev A.11 Figure 24 (p.63) shows R1 47k from CSN to VCC in the typical application; TS1702 Mini Board reference schematic carries the same R1 47k 0402; Trezor Safe 7 rev D TROPIC block uses 47k; board padnets.json shows TROPIC_SPI_CSN = {U2.8, U1.29} only.
findings.recommendation: Add 47k from TROPIC_SPI_CSN to TROPIC_VCC (the switched rail after U4/RJ1, NOT SYS_3V3, to avoid back-powering the IO while VCC is gated off; TROPIC01 abs-max IO = 3.6V).

findings.claim: Schematic sheets contain only the 11 major components (U1,U2,U5,U9,U11,J1,J2,J9,SW1...); all ~90 passives, load switches, ESD, crystals, jumpers exist only as PCB footprints, and the fab BOM (16 lines) contains zero passives - placeholder values (HSE_LOAD, NFC_TUNE, BL_SENSE) are unresolvable and nothing passive is procurable.
findings.evidence: grep of '"Reference"' across kicad/sheets/*.kicad_sch (stm32u5_host.kicad_sch contains only U1); production/bom/pcbway-bom.csv designators: U1-U11, J1/J2/J6/J9, SW1 only; 'HSE_LOAD' found only in the .kicad_pcb.
findings.recommendation: Back-annotate the full support network into the sheets (or formally declare the PCB source-of-truth and generate the BOM from board fields), then resolve every placeholder value before the PCBWay package is cut.

findings.evidence: pads.json distance computation; standard Infineon integration practice (OPTIGA Trust M DS Rev 3.70 host-connection figures include a VCC blocking cap).
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF from SYS_3V3 to GND at ~(16.5,40.8), within ~1.5mm of U11 pin 10.

findings.claim: W25Q128JVSIQ (U5) has no local decoupling: nearest cap to VCC pin 8 (pad 19.322,61.654) is C17 2.2uF at 3.64mm, which is also the de-facto bulk for the U1 VDDA corner.
findings.evidence: pads.json distance computation; all nine SYS_3V3 100nF caps (C50-C58) are allocated to U1 power pins.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF within ~1.5mm of U5 pin 8 (space at ~(20.5,61.0)). Positive note: JVSIQ suffix = QE=1 factory-set (W25Q128JV DS section 7.1.4), so IO2/IO3 direct wiring without pull-ups is correct - pin the exact suffix in the BOM.

findings.claim: VBAT_SENSE divider R20 1M / R21 330k gives ~248kOhm source impedance into ADC1_IN1 (PC0, pin 15) with no reservoir cap; DS Table 106 max RAIN for 14-bit ADC1 tops out at 470 Ohm for the specified sampling times - readings will be invalid.
findings.evidence: STM32U585 DS13086 Rev10 Table 106 p.246 (RAIN max 47-470 Ohm); padnets.json VBAT_SENSE = {R20.2, R21.1, U1.15}, no capacitor on the net.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF from VBAT_SENSE to GND at the pin (battery voltage is quasi-DC; sample from the reservoir with long sampling time), or rescale the divider to <=10k Thevenin.

findings.claim: VDDA and VREF+ are missing their 1uF caps (only 100nF C52/C53 present at 1.9-2.4mm) and there is no 10uF VDD bulk near U1 - DS power scheme requires 100nF+1uF on each of VDDA and VREF+, and n x 100nF + 1 x 10uF on VDD.
findings.evidence: STM32U585 DS13086 Rev10 Figure 24 p.155 (power supply scheme without SMPS); measured: nearest bulk to the VDDA corner is C17 2.2uF at ~4mm; total scattered rail bulk = 2.2+2.2+4.7uF with buck COUT ~20mm away.
findings.recommendation: Add 2x 1uF 0402 beside C52/C53 (left side, y~53-56) and 1x 10uF 0603 near the U1 bottom row (e.g. beside C59 at (32.5,59.5)).

findings.claim: LED_G is mapped to U1 pin 9 = PC15 (OSC32_OUT): PC15 has no timer alternate function at all (EVENTOUT only), so the ledger's 'PWM colour mixing' is impossible in hardware on that channel, and PC15 is a restricted backup-domain pin (2MHz/30pF, VSW-supplied).
findings.evidence: DS13086 AF table: PC15 row all '-' except EVENTOUT; note p.133: 'PC13,PC14,PC15 supplied through the power switch... must not be used as current sources (e.g. to drive a LED)' (sink at normal capability is allowed per section 5.3.15); pinmux-ledger.json declares PWM mixing and flags pinmux as pending.
findings.recommendation: Move LED_G to a free TIM-capable pin: U1 pins 38/39/40 = PE7/PE8/PE9 are all NC; PE9 = TIM1_CH1 (AF1) is the cleanest. LED_R PE3 = TIM3_CH1 is fine; LED_B PC1 only has LPTIM1_CH1 - consider PE8 (TIM1_CH1N) if uniform TIM PWM is wanted. Freeing PC14/PC15 also re-enables a future LSE crystal.

result.summary: The power tree exists only in the PCB netlist (schematic sheets are stubs; BOM lists majors only): USB-C J1 -> TPS2553 (U8) -> BQ24074 power-path charger (U10) -> SYS_PWR_IN -> TPS62840 3.3V buck (U3) + TPS61165 backlight boost (U15), with three TPS22917 islands (TROPIC/NFC/display). IC pin mappings are essentially all correct (BQ24074, TPS2553, TPS62840, TPS22917 incl. QOD-to-VOUT, TPS61165) and the current budget verdict is that the TPS62840 750mA buck is ADEQUATE (~460-580mA worst realistic, backlight correctly NOT on 3.3V). However the design has one broken topology (boost driving a 4-parallel-LED 3.2V backlight from a 4.4V node: cannot regulate, ~4x LED overdrive, backlight cannot be switched off), mis-programmed resistors (788mA charge into a 150-300mAh battery; 1.36A charger input limit above the 0.96A front-end switch and the 500mA USB budget), systematic missing/misplaced power capacitors (zero cap on charger IN and BAT, 1uF-only on OUT, buck output cap 37.6mm away, NFC rail 100nF-only at 12.4mm), an ST25R3916B VDD_RF/VDD_DR strap matching neither datasheet configuration, and a TROPIC01 VCC ramp (1.6ms via CT=1nF) violating its 1ms limit. Trezor Safe 7 (same TROPIC01+ST25R3916B) uses an nPM1300 PMIC and a series-string backlight boost, validating our part choices but not the backlight wiring. All fixable at schematic/value level before routing completion.

findings.claim: TPS61165 boost backlight topology is invalid for the ER-TFT024IPS-3 panel: 4 parallel LEDs (common anode, Vf~3.2V, 80mA total) need VOUT~3.4V while VIN=SYS_PWR_IN is 4.4V on USB (BQ24074 VO(REG)) and 3.0-4.2V on battery; a boost cannot regulate below VIN, the DC path VIN->L15(49,63.5)->D15(46.5,67.5)->LEDA overdrives LEDs ~4x, and the backlight cannot be hardware-disabled (no load disconnect) whenever SYS_PWR_IN>~3.55V

findings.recommendation: Replace U15/L15/D15/C13/C15/R15 with a 4-channel current-sink or charge-pump WLED driver running from SYS_PWR_IN with PWM dimming; fallback is re-feeding a boost from SYS_3V3 (degenerate 3.3->3.4V duty, adds ~90-100mA to buck budget) - inferior

findings.claim: ST25R3916B driver supply strap matches neither documented configuration: VDD_DR (U9 pin14) is tied to raw NFC_VCC while VDD_RF (pin9) floats on its own 100nF (C38) - datasheet requires either VDD_RF externally tied to VDD_DR (regulator mode, recommended) or BOTH VDD_RF and VDD_DR tied to VDD_TX (bypass mode for >350mArms)

findings.claim: TROPIC01 VCC rise time violates the datasheet 1ms ramp limit: TPS22917 with CT=C6=1nF gives tR ~1.6ms (1.6us/pF at VIN 3.6V, slower at 3.3V) vs TROPIC01 TVCC_RAMPUP <= 1ms

result.reasoning: Every checkable electrical claim verifies against primary sources. (1) Inductance: reproduced the bundle-GMD Grover computation exactly — depth 2.5mm, avg dims 31.1x3.5mm, r_eq=0.5666mm, L1=23.33nH x16 = 373.3 nH; ST's own AN2866-style formula (d_eq=2(w+t)/pi, N^1.8) gives 445 nH, so 373-445 nH bare and 400-480 nH with ferrite are consistent; the N=5 fallback recomputes to 520.3 nH as claimed (caveat: its inner aperture collapses to 0.5mm). (2) AN5276 Rev 6 (local PDF text): the 200-1500 nH target window is verbatim at the p.24/25 boundary as cited; sec 4.2 gives the 926 nH / 394 mOhm example and the 1-300 MHz VNA Smith-chart procedure; sec 4.3 gives Q=RPANT/(omega*LANT)=34.8 — so the finding's Q~35 equals ST's own reference antenna. (3) The 886 nH / 15 Ohm DISCO pairing is corroborated by ST community moderator posts referencing AN5592. (4) F.Cu is the device back (J2+display outline on B.Cu = front), matching the design note's 'back-side loop'. Minor internal inconsistency, not refuting: the stated Rac method (Rdc 0.34 Ohm, K_skin~1 at t~2*delta, +15% proximity) yields ~0.39 Ohm/Q~64, not 0.9 Ohm/Q~35 — the 0.9 Ohm value implies a ~2.3x proximity factor, which is the realistic figure (AN5276's antenna shows ~5x DC loss at 13.56MHz), so the deliverable number is right even if the derivation narrative underestimates proximity. HOWEVER the recommendation as written is not implementable on the current board (measured from the .kicad_pcb): the rectangle x15.2-48.8/y31.6-37.6 has hard copper/hole collisions — J9 MP pads x[46.60,48.10] and x[39.90,41.40], y[32.90,36.30] sit inside the right/top/bottom winding bands; J6 MP pads x[15.60,16.80]/[21.20,22.40], y[33.73,35.52] cut three bands; J7 TC2030 upper pad row (y37.47-38.26) and its NPTH hole at (30.54,37.48) punch the bottom band; TP_UART_GND pad at (25,35) and parked C31(32,32)/C33(32,34) also collide. Worse, point-in-polygon tests show the In1.Cu GND plane is FILLED at every sampled point of the region (plus F.Cu pour, 22 F.Cu + 7 In2.Cu segments, 4 vias) and the finding omits the mandatory all-layer copper keepout that the project's own nfc-rf-frontend.md already requires — without it the 373 nH free-space model is invalid. Also, nets NFC_ANT1/NFC_ANT2 do not exist; the ST25R3916B symbol RF pins are DNC and the design note plans ANT_A/ANT_B. These are recommendation defects, not claim errors, hence CONFIRMED with corrections. result.area: MCU + secure elements (STM32U585, TROPIC01, OPTIGA, W25Q128, USB, SWD/testpoints)
result.summary: The core digital design is fundamentally sound: U1's per-pin decoupling is complete and well placed (9x100nF all within 2.1mm, VCAP 4.7uF at 1.8mm), the entire pinmux is valid, TROPIC01 pin tie-offs match DS Fig 24 exactly, the TPS22917 power-gate topology is correct, and the W25Q128JVSIQ suffix choice makes the pull-up-less quad wiring legal. Four issues are blocking-grade: HSE load caps have literal placeholder values with one cap stranded 12.6mm from the crystal; NRST has no capacitor (DS Fig 38 requires 100nF close to the device); the reference-design 47k MISO(SDO) pull-up on the TROPIC01 SPI is missing (libtropic's L1 protocol depends on reading 0xFF from an undriven SDO); and the schematic sheets capture only the 11 major parts, so ~90 passives exist only as PCB footprints with several unresolved placeholder values and a 15-line BOM. A second tier of fixes covers missing local decoupling at OPTIGA and W25Q128, missing VDDA/VREF+/bulk caps, a VBAT_SENSE divider that violates the ADC RAIN limit by 500x, the USB ESD chip placed as a 9mm lateral stub, LED_G on a PWM-less power-switch-domain pin, and the six contract-required testpoints which I propose placing grouped around the TC2030. Implement as a single KiCad rule area on all 4 copper layers (no copper pour, no tracks, no vias); AN2972 sec 3.5.2 forbids copper below the antenna traces, not merely below the aperture. Note the antenna feed exception is currently moot: RFO1/RFO2 matching from U9 @(40.17,48) is unrouted (among the 69 opens); NFC_VDD_AM and NFC_AGDC tracks now in the band are supply/measurement nets, not the feed, and must be rerouted out like the rest. Reroute the 22-31 offending segments (SYS_3V3 run at y~34.7-37.5 is the bulk, plus SWCLK/SWDIO to J7, VBUS, NFC_AGDC, NFC_VDD_AM, CHARGER_ITERM, NFC_XTO, TOUCH_I2C) and the 3-5 vias southward. Keep the spoked/slotted-pour rule outside the aperture (no closed conductive ring, per AN2972 Fig 16). Do the reroute BEFORE the pending GND via stitching, otherwise the currently-empty B.Cu fill will flow up into the band.
